name: Automate WhatsApp Appointment Reminders, Interactive Poll Confirmations, and Rescheduling with Google Sheets and Supergreen

parameters.content:
## Automate WhatsApp Appointment Reminders, Poll Confirmations & Rescheduling

### Who this is for
Clinics, salons, coaching practices, and field-service teams managing bookings in Google Sheets and Google Calendar that want 1-tap interactive WhatsApp confirmation polls without Meta Business template approvals.

### What problem it solves
Plain SMS/WhatsApp text reminders require free-text replies (`"yes"`, `"can we move to Thursday?"`) that are brittle to parse, while official WhatsApp Cloud API templates cannot send native WhatsApp Polls. This workflow closes the loop end-to-end:
1. **Flow A (Hourly Outbound Dispatch):** Reads `Appointments` from Google Sheets, filters `Scheduled` bookings due within the next `reminderWindowHours` (default `24h`) that haven't received a reminder yet, verifies the Google Calendar event still exists (skipping cancelled calendar events), sends an interactive 3-option WhatsApp Poll (`Confirm attendance`, `Running 10 min late`, `Need to reschedule`), and writes `reminderSent = yes` + `reminderSentAt` back to the sheet.
2. **Flow B (Real-Time Poll Vote Callback):** Listens for incoming WhatsApp `vote` events via **Supergreen Trigger**, matches the voter's phone number to their active upcoming booking in Google Sheets, updates `status` (`Confirmed`, `Running Late`, or `Reschedule Requested`), replies to the client (sending your self-serve booking link when rescheduling), and alerts your staff WhatsApp group whenever someone is running late or needs to reschedule.

### Community Node & Compatibility
- **Community node:** `n8n-nodes-supergreen` (tested with `v0.1.5` on n8n `v1.76+`).
- **Platform support:** `n8n-nodes-supergreen` is a **verified community node**, so it works directly on **n8n Cloud** (search `Supergreen` in the nodes panel) and on self-hosted n8n (`Settings -> Community Nodes -> n8n-nodes-supergreen`). Docs & npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/n8n-nodes-supergreen

### Setup steps
1. Create a Google Sheet tab named `Appointments` with columns: `bookingId`, `phone`, `clientName`, `serviceName`, `appointmentIso`, `calendarEventId`, `status`, `reminderSent`, `reminderSentAt`, `lastVoteAt`.
2. Connect credentials: **Supergreen API** (from https://supergreen.cc), **Google Sheets OAuth2**, and **Google Calendar OAuth2**.
3. Open **Configure Clinic Settings** (Flow A) and **Configure Callback Settings** (Flow B) to set `businessName`, `spreadsheetId`, `calendarId`, `rescheduleUrl`, and `staffGroupChatId` (`YOUR_STAFF_GROUP_ID@g.us`).
4. Activate the workflow.

### Edge cases & limitations
- Duplicate reminders are prevented via `reminderSent = yes`. If you reschedule a row manually, clear `reminderSent` so the new slot receives a reminder.
- If a client changes their poll vote, Flow B updates the sheet with their latest selection and `lastVoteAt` timestamp.

## Flow A: Hourly Reminder Scanner, Calendar Cross-Check & Interactive WhatsApp Poll

Scans `Appointments` hourly, filters unsent `Scheduled` bookings inside the reminder window, cross-checks Google Calendar so cancelled events aren't messaged, sends a 3-choice WhatsApp Poll, and records `reminderSent = yes`.

## Flow B: Real-Time WhatsApp Poll Vote Listener, Sheet Sync & Staff Escalation

Captures native WhatsApp `vote` events, looks up the client's active booking in Google Sheets, updates attendance status, sends the client a confirmation or reschedule link, and alerts the staff WhatsApp group for late/reschedule votes.
